senses.definition: Expresses an estimate or an approximate time or amount.

contexts.text: About ten children came to the party.
We arrived at about noon.
It takes about five minutes.
About twenty people joined the game.

senses.definition: Introduces the person, thing, or topic being discussed.

contexts.text: This story is about a dog.
They talked about the school trip.
She thinks about her new art project.
The book is about a family dinner.

senses.definition: Indicates that someone or something is able to perform an action.

contexts.text: I can cook dinner.
The bird can fly.
Maya can make dinner for everyone.
A cat can climb a tree.

senses.definition: A cylindrical container used for food or drinks.

contexts.text: She opened a can of soup.
He drank a can of soda.
Put the empty can in the recycling bin.
The metal can is on the shelf.

senses.sense_label: affection for a person or animal
senses.definition: Expresses relational affection toward a person or animal.

contexts.text: I love my family.
The child loves her dog.
Maya loves her mother and father.
We love our friends.

senses.sense_label: strongly enjoy a thing or activity
senses.definition: Expresses strong enjoyment or preference for an object, food, or activity.

contexts.text: I love to paint.
They love pizza.
The children love playing basketball.
We love this delicious soup.
